methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
Two candidate UNDP catalogs were compared. www.undp.org/publications sits behind a strict Cloudflare/WAF that returns HTTP 403 to non-browser User-Agents, making it unreliable for automated scraping without a full browser. climatepromise.undp.org/research-and-reports is fully server-rendered and returns clean HTML to a plain fetch, yielding ~12 scrapable report links per page across ~20 pages.

## Recommendation
RECOMMEND climatepromise.undp.org/research-and-reports as the default source: it produced consistently scrapable document links with no WAF block, whereas the main undp.org/publications endpoint was blocked. The main site remains usable only if a browser-grade User-Agent/cookie handling is added.

## Search
Neither candidate exposed a reliable dedicated search endpoint for automated use; discovery is via browsing + facets. Search capability is therefore not claimed.

## Filters
The Climate Promise listing exposes country / region / area-of-work facets and pagination (?page=N) as URL parameters. Treated as opaque params; no formal schema.

## Download
Cards link to /research-and-reports/{slug} record pages. PDFs are exposed on the record page, not the listing, so a two-step crawl is required.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Title, date and short description are in server-rendered HTML. No JSON/REST API; enrichment is HTML-based.

## Limitations
HONEST: main undp.org/publications returned 403 (WAF), not a JS-SPA issue. Chosen Climate Promise sub-site is topically scoped to climate/NDC work, so it is narrower than the org-wide catalog. Pagination ?page=N.
probeNotes: www.undp.org/publications -> HTTP 403 (Cloudflare/WAF). climatepromise.undp.org/research-and-reports -> server-rendered HTML, ~12 links/page, ~20 pages, record URL /research-and-reports/{slug}, ?page=N pagination confirmed. Recommended Climate Promise for higher scrapable-link yield without WAF block.
